endpoint: 6 h target-gene RNA; repeat inventory for each separate assay/endpoint
excludes: independent pilot of at least four complete days
primary_estimand: C = (Delta_E_M - Delta_U_M) - (Delta_E_T - Delta_U_T); Delta = mutant drug-minus-vehicle minus WT drug-minus-vehicle
minimum_precision_target: 95% CI half-width 0.5 log2 units, sample size fixed from separate pilot; not an equivalence margin
scope: Linker-EGFP fusion architecture, not EGFP alone; mature RNA abundance unless nascent RNA validated
